_comment: Hand-verified upstream licences for packages whose Open VSX `license` field is a pointer (SEE LICENSE IN / empty / NOASSERTION). Recorded by FOSS_EXTENSION_REPOSITORY.md: the registry field alone is not a grant, so each of these was read from the upstream LICENSE file on the date shown. tools/openvsx-scan.mjs upgrades a `verify` verdict to `verified` when an entry below matches — re-check and update `checked` before each catalog release.

tamasfe.even-better-toml.source: github.com/tamasfe/taplo LICENSE (registry points at this repo)

googlecloudtools.cloudcode.source: github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-code-vscode LICENSE = Google Cloud Code Plugin Software License Agreement — proprietary, refuse

qwtel.sqlite-viewer.source: github.com/qwtel/sqlite-viewer-vscode LICENSE.md is a PRO activation notice — freemium, refuse

Redis.redis-for-vscode.source: github.com/redis/Redis-for-VS-Code LICENSE — Server Side Public License, not OSI-approved, refuse

Anthropic.claude-code.source: registry field is Anthropic's legal notice; upstream reports NONE — refuse

eamodio.gitlens.source: registry placeholder %gitlens.license%; GitKraken freemium terms — refuse

openai.chatgpt.source: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md → proprietary terms — refuse (CLI core openai/codex is Apache-2.0)

openai.codex-audio.source: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md → proprietary terms — refuse

Google.geminicodeassist.source: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE → service EULA — refuse

Google.google-antigravity.source: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.txt, no public repo — refuse

robertpiosik.gemini-coder.source: GitHub license API NONE — no license file — refuse

bmewburn.vscode-intelephense-client.source: custom SEE LICENSE IN with no public repo — treat as non-FOSS

ms-vscode.live-server.source: registry license NONE / service terms — refuse

devhakeem5.codex-hub.source: registry empty, no upstream checked; excluded on usefulness (account rotation has no DWCode capability)

zixfel.codex-account-swapper.source: registry empty; excluded on usefulness — account rotation has no DWCode capability

DiemasMichiels.emulate.source: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE — no SPDX grant — refuse

vscode.git.source: Theia-republished builtin under the VS Code package license — reference only, never indexed

vscode.rust.source: Theia-republished builtin under the VS Code package license — reference only, never indexed

SonarSource.sonarlint-vscode.source: github.com/SonarSource/sonarlint-vscode (GitHub license API: LGPL-3.0) — external process only

Google.gemini-cli-vscode-ide-companion.source: registry repository field points at github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli (Apache-2.0)

jlcodes.antigravity-cockpit.source: licence clean; excluded separately on usefulness (reads a Google IDE's quotas, which DWCode is not)

mhutchie.git-graph.source: registry license empty and the GitHub repo returned 404 — do not adopt until status is confirmed

dbcode.dbcode.source: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE with no SPDX grant — service client, refuse

Vue.volar.source: registry license field empty; upstream github.com/vuejs/language-tools is MIT (GitHub license API) — the last pending row, now cleared
